origin.thread_label: Owner-authorized S1 G1 native transport reliability follow-on after #1877 merge

title: S1 G1 proof: authenticate existing cross-agent receiver ACK and actual native job completion
objective: Add the smallest source-bound, read-only native GitHub provenance adapter for the existing S1 handoff chain. The merged shape-only validator reports authenticated_delivery=false and actual_job_execution_proven=false even for structurally complete receipts. Preserve this honest boundary; independently verify real recipient identity, source/head binding, native issue/PR actor, completed specific GitHub run/job and received result before S1 can mark a request delivered. Remain in the existing #1156 owner, without a new transport, supervisor, scheduler, writer, paid API or automatic release authority. This is G1 phase 1, not claim of genuine recipient execution until a natural live cross-repository case is observed.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/governance/s1_agent_handoff_receipts_v1.py only if a minimal backward-compatible adapter hook is unavoidable

evidence.summary: Actual original #1877 merged to main; all 10 exact-head workflows passed; source job proof still absent
validate_chain explicitly authenticates only shape and consistently sets delivery/job proven=false
G0 main readback verified, G1 recipient native ACK and actual execution explicitly open
Source of current authenticated-receipt wiring and regression suite

reproduction: On current main, construct a syntactically complete REQUESTED, ACKNOWLEDGED, ACCEPTED, RESULT_DELIVERED and S1_VERIFIED chain using only a plausible github.com native_event_url and actor labels. Call scripts.governance.s1_agent_handoff_receipts_v1.validate_chain. It must return authenticated_delivery=false and actual_job_execution_proven=false because no authenticated GitHub API actor/run/job validation is performed. This is an intentionally honest missing integration, not proof of a forged execution. Create a read-only adapter, accepting injected native transport to independently corroborate each claimed event and the exact recipient run/job. Prove it cannot infer success from comments, other PR checks or source label alone.

positive: Exact source-bound request, authenticated expected receiving GitHub bot/user, native issue comment/PR event binding and COMPLETED SUCCESS specific downstream job produce a source-bound OBSERVED_EXECUTION receipt, never self-granting release
Existing shape-only validation and 10/10 merged S1 PR regression contracts remain backward compatible
Native read-only proof reports actual actor, job/run IDs and origin fingerprint without raw/private payload
negative: Forged actor or changed comment author; unrelated run/job; stale source HEAD; conflicting source fingerprints; replay of another work_id all fail closed
Queued, cancelled, failed, skipped or zero-substantive-step job never qualifies as actual execution
Grok COMMENTED, Codex candidate READY or S1's own sender message are not treated as independent receiving ACK or actual job result
Offline provider/GitHub 403/404 and incomplete native evidence remain UNKNOWN or BLOCKED, not success; no retries that create paid inference or duplicate requests
A mutation that removes source/head/actor/job guards makes critical negative tests fail in isolation

forbidden_changes: new supervisor, schedule, queue or cross-repository writer
automatic release, auto trading, historical receipt rewrite or scientific promotion
post_fix_gate: Native authenticated recipient ACK and downstream actual job result on an original legitimate work_id, current main/blob readback, independent technical review, positive/negative/mutation tests, one natural G1 case before VERIFIED
